Description: Semantic page shell with header navigation footer skip link and responsive grid.
Acceptance criteria: Works from 320px to desktop without horizontal overflow; keyboard navigation is visible and usable; skip link reaches main content.

Description: Identity headline concise role statement primary project action secondary GitHub action and native engineering visual.
Dependencies: Approved identity and positioning; verified GitHub destination; approved visual concept
Acceptance criteria: No invented employers metrics or outcomes; project action reaches Selected Projects; GitHub opens the supplied verified profile.

Description: Two or three visual cards summarize problem solution technical approach contribution and relevant tags.
Dependencies: At least one approved project record and media/diagram; source or detail URLs when available
Acceptance criteria: Only verified published projects render; cards identify the developer's contribution and link only to working supplied destinations; artwork has captions and alt text.

Description: Readable case-study structure for context constraints role approach decisions trade-offs testing evidence and links.
Dependencies: Sufficient verified project details; media permissions
Acceptance criteria: Each published page distinguishes individual contribution from team/project context; unknown outcomes are omitted; navigation returns to projects.

Description: Grouped capability list covering stated Swift/UIKit SwiftUI/concurrency SDKs networking modularization testing and tooling.
Acceptance criteria: Capabilities render as semantic groups without proficiency bars or unsupported ranking.

Description: Short real examples showing architecture choice trade-off problem-solving and maintenance/testing consequence.
Dependencies: At least one approved technical story
Acceptance criteria: Every example has context, decision, trade-off, and verified detail; no fabricated case appears publicly.

Description: Professional introduction philosophy and optional current learning direction.
Dependencies: Approved About copy; optional learning statement
Acceptance criteria: Only supplied/approved personal claims render; learning direction can be omitted without leaving an empty UI.

Description: GitHub and any verified email or professional links.
Dependencies: GitHub URL verification; real email and other profiles if used
Acceptance criteria: No dead, placeholder, or invented links; GitHub remains available if email is absent.

Description: Simple navigation copyright current year page metadata favicon and social preview metadata.
Dependencies: Display name; domain if available; approved preview artwork
Acceptance criteria: Footer links work; copyright year is current; title and description are present; canonical is omitted until domain is confirmed.

Description: Compact links or accessible menu for narrow screens with open/closed states.
Acceptance criteria: Menu can be opened and closed by keyboard; Escape closes it; focus remains managed; section links are touch friendly.

Description: Semantic landmarks focus styles contrast reduced-motion support and media alternatives.
Acceptance criteria: All actions work by keyboard; text contrast meets WCAG AA; reduced-motion mode removes nonessential motion; videos have captions or transcript.

Description: Static-first Astro build and Vercel deployment with preview URLs and no backend or paid service dependency.
Acceptance criteria: Production build emits static assets; preview deployment is reachable; runtime requires no database or paid API.

Description: Helpful not-found page with a return path to the portfolio.
Acceptance criteria: Unknown routes show a clear 404 and a working home link.

Description: Reusable image diagram and optional video treatment with responsive sizing and labels.
Acceptance criteria: Media preserves aspect ratio, includes alt/caption, loads responsively, and does not autoplay.

Description: Small hover/focus and entry transitions that reinforce hierarchy.
Acceptance criteria: Motion is brief and nonessential; reduced-motion preference disables it; content is visible without animation.

Description: Optional light dark or system preference control.
Acceptance criteria: Theme selection is keyboard accessible, persists without blocking initial content, and maintains contrast in each mode.

Description: Curated articles/notes about real technical learning or decisions.
Dependencies: Approved writing content and editorial cadence
Acceptance criteria: Only authored material is listed; each item has date/title/summary and a stable destination.
